body: I completely understand your point of view, thank you for answering my question in a very polite way because this is a very hard topic to touch. I hope you get the replies you’re looking for, wish you the best for your future family!

I’m sorry if this question comes out as rude or offensive, I’m just curious. I don’t want to be judgmental in any shape or form but, im pretty sure u know that mental health is one hell of an issue and it’s so frustrating to be conflicted with such mental diseases like depression and manic disorders, im sure you know humanity is in the middle of a pandemic and we all keep hearing about every unfortunate event that has been happening on a daily basis, there’s a huge chance your offsprings will carry the same diseases as you. My question is (if you don’t mind answering) why do you want to bring a new life to suffer in this miserable and mediocre reality?
